sub_graphs.title: EIP-8070: Sparse Blobpool Transaction Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of blob transactions through probabilistic sampling from announcement to inclusion

nodes.label: Blob Transaction Announced
nodes.description: Node has received NewPooledTransactionHashes announcement for type-3 blob transaction

nodes.label: Make Probabilistic Role Decision
nodes.description: With probability p=0.15, decide to become provider; otherwise become sampler

nodes.label: Assigned Provider Role
nodes.description: Node will fetch full blob payload and serve to other peers

nodes.label: Assigned Sampler Role
nodes.description: Node will fetch only transaction payload and sample cells from providers

nodes.label: Fetch Full Blob Payload
nodes.description: Request signed transaction and full blob data via devp2p from announcing peer

nodes.label: Fetch Transaction Only
nodes.description: Request only transaction payload via GetPooledTransactions

nodes.label: Awaiting Provider Announcements
nodes.description: Sampler waiting for at least 2 distinct provider announcements

nodes.label: Request Custody-Aligned Cells
nodes.description: Request custody columns plus C_extra=1 random column, max C_req=8 columns per request

nodes.label: Cells Received
nodes.description: Sampler has received requested cell data from providers

nodes.label: Validate Retrieved Data
nodes.description: Validate data per EIP-7594 specifications before propagation

nodes.label: Blob Data Validated
nodes.description: Blob transaction data has passed all validation checks

nodes.label: Announce to Peers
nodes.description: Provider announces with all-ones cell_mask; sampler propagates based on available data

nodes.label: Transaction in Pool
nodes.description: Validated blob transaction is in local mempool

external_entities.name: P2P Peer Node
external_entities.description: Connected peer node announcing blob transactions via devp2p eth/71 protocol

sub_graphs.title: EIP-8070: eth/71 Protocol Messages
sub_graphs.description: Models the new and modified devp2p messages for sparse blobpool

nodes.label: Message Received from Peer
nodes.description: Raw devp2p message received from connected peer

nodes.label: Parse NewPooledTransactionHashes (0x08)
nodes.description: Parse message with new cell_mask field for type-3 transactions

nodes.label: Parse GetPooledTransactions (0x09)
nodes.description: Parse request for pooled transactions

nodes.label: Parse PooledTransactions (0x10)
nodes.description: Parse response with blob payloads elided (RLP nil literals)

nodes.label: Parse GetCells (0x12)
nodes.description: Parse request for specific cells: [[hash_0, ...], cell_mask]

nodes.label: Parse Cells (0x13)
nodes.description: Parse response: [[hash_0, ...], cells, cell_mask]

nodes.label: Announcement Parsed
nodes.description: NewPooledTransactionHashes parsed with cell_mask extracted

nodes.label: Cells Request Ready
nodes.description: GetCells request parsed and ready for processing

nodes.label: Cells Response Ready
nodes.description: Cells response prepared for sending

nodes.label: Validate Cell Mask Format
nodes.description: Ensure cell_mask is nil when no type-3 TXs, or valid B_16 bitmap otherwise

nodes.label: Send GetCells Request
nodes.description: Send GetCells message requesting specific columns from peer

nodes.label: Send Cells Response
nodes.description: Send Cells message with requested cell data

external_entities.name: P2P Peer Node
external_entities.description: Connected peer sending/receiving eth/71 protocol messages

sub_graphs.title: EIP-8070: Sampling Noise and Misbehavior Detection
sub_graphs.description: Models the security mechanisms for detecting malicious peers via sampling noise

nodes.label: Preparing Cell Request
nodes.description: Node is preparing to request cells from a provider

nodes.label: Select Custody-Aligned Columns
nodes.description: Select columns from node's custody set for request

nodes.label: Add Random Noise Column
nodes.description: Add C_extra=1 randomly selected column outside custody set

nodes.label: Request Includes Noise
nodes.description: Cell request contains custody columns plus noise column

nodes.label: Send Cell Request to Provider
nodes.description: Send GetCells request to peer claiming provider role

nodes.label: Awaiting Provider Response
nodes.description: Waiting for Cells response from provider

nodes.label: Check Noise Column Response
nodes.description: Verify that provider returned the noise column correctly

nodes.label: Noise Column Missing
nodes.description: Provider failed to return the random noise column

nodes.label: Noise Column Valid
nodes.description: Provider correctly returned noise column - likely honest

nodes.label: Flag Peer Misbehavior
nodes.description: Mark peer as potentially malicious based on noise column failure

nodes.label: Consider Peer Disconnection
nodes.description: Potentially disconnect peer exceeding fairness quotas

nodes.label: Peer Flagged for Misbehavior
nodes.description: Peer has been marked as potentially malicious

external_entities.name: Provider Peer
external_entities.description: Peer claiming to have full blob data (provider role)

sub_graphs.title: EIP-8070: Block Builder Blob Inclusion Policies
sub_graphs.description: Models the three configurable policies for including blobs in locally built blocks

nodes.label: Building Local Block
nodes.description: Node is preparing to propose a block and must decide on blob inclusion

nodes.label: Check Blob Availability Status
nodes.description: Determine availability status of candidate blob transactions

nodes.label: Conservative Policy Active
nodes.description: Only include blobs with full local availability

nodes.label: Optimistic Policy Active
nodes.description: Include blobs that have been successfully sampled

nodes.label: Proactive Policy Active
nodes.description: Resample blobs before proposal time

nodes.label: Include Full Availability Blobs Only
nodes.description: Conservative: only include blobs where full data is locally available

nodes.label: Include Successfully Sampled Blobs
nodes.description: Optimistic: include blobs that passed sampling validation

nodes.label: Resample Blobs Before Proposal
nodes.description: Proactive: request fresh samples before including in block

nodes.label: Blob Transactions Selected
nodes.description: Final set of blob transactions selected for block inclusion

ambiguities.text: The decision mechanism MAY be remembered for some period chosen by the implementer
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementations may cache role decisions for varying periods. This creates inconsistent behavior across nodes and potential timing-based attacks.

ambiguities.text: Specific heuristics remain implementation-defined per design choice - no normative peer scoring system specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume nodes have implementation-specific peer scoring and disconnection logic. This may lead to divergent network behavior under attack.

ambiguities.text: Threat modeling for selective withholding and eclipse attacks marked as TBD
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume these attack vectors exist but mitigations are incomplete. Security analysis should treat these as open risks.

ambiguities.text: RBF impact analysis marked as TBD
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume replace-by-fee interactions with sparse blobpool are not fully analyzed. May create edge cases where replaced transactions are inconsistently propagated.

implicit_assumptions.description: Network mesh degree D=50 is maintained and peers are randomly distributed (not eclipsed)
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: With lower mesh degree or eclipsed nodes, probability of having sufficient providers drops, potentially causing data unavailability.

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot predict which nodes will become providers for a given transaction
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Targeted attacks on provider nodes could cause selective data unavailability for specific transactions.

implicit_assumptions.description: At least some providers are honest and will serve noise columns correctly
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If all providers are malicious and coordinate, noise-based detection fails and selective withholding becomes undetectable.

implicit_assumptions.description: Nodes implement fair request load-balancing across samplers
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Provider nodes could be overwhelmed by requests, causing DoS or forcing them to drop data.

implicit_assumptions.description: 64 cells are sufficient for reconstruction threshold
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If reconstruction requires more cells and not enough honest samplers exist, blob data cannot be recovered.
